## New experiment result

**Experiment:** 
**Outcome:** win | loss | inconclusive
**Decision:** ship | iterate | roll back | retest

### Checklist
- [ ] Result file follows `templates/experiment-result-template.md`
- [ ] File is named `results/{year}/{yyyy-mm-dd}-{experiment-slug}.md`
- [ ] Row added to `INDEX.md`
- [ ] Numbers match the Optimizely results page
- [ ] Experiment owner has reviewed the learnings and next steps
